subject: POC planning: Verdant Health — success criteria & RACI
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@verdanthealth.com>, Emily Carter <emily.carter@verdanthealth.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-03-09T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC planning: Verdant Health (post-call recap)

Hi Sanjay / Emily —

Thanks again for the call today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment heading into a trial/POC:

Key goals we heard from you:
- Validate latency and cost on your typical clinical ingestion workloads (batch patient notes + real-time triage prompts)
- Verify data residency and encryption controls for PHI workflows
- Confirm integration pattern with your app (API + prefix caching) and run a short QA evaluation with 50k tokens/day equivalent

Proposed POC high level:
- Duration: 3 weeks (2-week evaluation + 1-week wrap/analysis)
- Success criteria: 1) <150ms p95 for 512-token responses on dedicated pool, 2) results parity on our eval prompts with baseline model (>=95% passing), 3) no PHI egress and support for KMS-managed keys
- Ownership ask: please confirm who on your side owns infra, app, security, and procurement so we can map RACI and unblock provisioning

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm owners and procurement timeline (reply to this thread)
2) We send a written POC plan and resource ask (we'll include infra config + security checklist) — target by EOD today
3) Kickoff call to align on data ingestion details and test prompts (week of 3/22)

I attached a short one-page draft POC plan and a security checklist for initial review.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

POC timeline (proposed)
- Kickoff: week of 3/22
- Provision infra & access: 3/22-3/24
- Data ingestion + baseline runs: 3/25-3/29
- Evaluation window (2 weeks): 3/30-4/12
- Wrap & findings: week of 4/13

Success criteria (pass/fail):
- Latency: p95 <150ms for 512-token responses on the dedicated pool under your 99th percentile traffic shape
- Quality: >=95% passing rate on the 25 eval prompts you shared (we'll run automated scoring + one manual pass)
- Security: no PHI egress, KMS-backed encryption at rest, and audit logs accessible to your team for the evaluation window

RACI (proposed)
- Infra provisioning: R=neha_kapoor, A=marissa_cole, C=Priya Natarajan (Verdant), I=Emily Carter
- App integration and runbooks: R=Emily Carter (Verdant), A=Emily Carter, C=neha_kapoor, I=marissa_cole
- Security review & questionnaire: R=Dinesh Patel (Verdant) & vivek_kulkarni (Redwood), A=Dinesh Patel, C=vivek_kulkarni, I=marissa_cole
- Procurement / PO: R=procurement@verdanthealth.com, A=procurement@verdanthealth.com, C=marissa_cole, I=Emily Carter

Resource ask from Redwood:
- Dedicated small GPU pool (1-2 gpus) for evaluation window
- Service account with restricted access for data ingestion
- Access to the 25 eval prompts (you can drop them to the Drive link)

Neha will own provisioning and will follow up with exact VM/network requirements. Vivek will follow up on SOC2 and the security checklist. I've attached our SOC2 summary as redwood_soc2_summary.pdf for Dinesh.

If you confirm owners and a kickoff week of 3/22, I'll trigger procurement paperwork and a short kickoff invite for the 30-min alignment call.

Thanks —
Marissa

Hi all — looping in a quick infra checklist and what I'll need to provision.

Minimum infra ask for evaluation:
- Dedicated pool: 1x A10G or equivalent (GPU) / 16GB RAM / 200GB ephemeral storage
- Network: outbound to api.redwood.ai and our metrics endpoints; allow ports 443 only
- KMS: customer-managed keys preferred; we can fall back to Redwood-managed if procurement is slow
- Service account: token-based service account with read-only access to the eval dataset container

I will own provisioning (R). Timeline: I can provision the dedicated pool in 24-48 hours after access is confirmed. I'll follow up with a short provisioning runbook and an IP allowlist request.

On the data side, please share a sanitized sample and the 25 eval prompts in the Drive folder.

Thanks —
